article_notes: 92 dogs with babesiosis (intraerythrocytic parasites on blood smear; species not identified) meeting SIRS, severe sepsis or septic shock criteria, Madras Veterinary College, April-December 2021; 10 healthy controls. Survivors (n=69) vs non-survivors (n=23) split 'based on the treatment response'; follow-up horizon not stated. Statistics: one-way ANOVA across control, survivors and non-survivors with superscripts for pairwise differences; survivor vs non-survivor significance was taken from the superscripts. Several significance symbols after F values were lost in conversion, and the footnote ('*p < 0.005 -significant, p < 0.01 -highly significant') is internally odd. Inconsistencies: (1) the text says WBC count, platelet count and albumin were significantly lower in non-survivors than survivors, but the superscripts show no survivor vs non-survivor difference for these (rows marked unclear); (2) mortality by cardiac dysfunction (23/31 + 19/61 = 42 deaths) conflicts with the 23 non-survivors in the tables. Not extracted: the statement 'Cardiac dysfunction in canine babesiosis was associated with multi organ dysfunction syndrome (MODS) and severity of the infection' (sentence truncated in the Markdown, no data), ECG findings (described only within dogs with cardiac dysfunction, not by outcome), and metabolic acidosis (compared only with controls; counted in skipped_infected_vs_healthy).

severity_definitions.definition: Dogs split into survivors and non-survivors based on the treatment response; follow-up horizon not stated. All dogs met SIRS, severe sepsis or septic shock criteria; dogs with pre-existing cardiac disease, diabetes, ARDS, creatinine above 7 mg/dL or chronic renal disease were excluded.
severity_definitions.quote: The dogs were split into two groups as survivors and non survivors based on the treatment response.

associations.location: Results and discussion, para 1
associations.note: Reported as mortality by cardiac dysfunction status (23 + 19 = 42 deaths), which conflicts with the 23 non-survivors in Tables 1-2; n_severe/n_comparison here are dogs with (31) and without (61) cardiac dysfunction, not survivors/non-survivors. No test reported. Abstract gives survival 26% (8/31) with cardiac dysfunction.
